datum_evidence_reviews.evidence: The NGSA mercury CSV declares its datum in the coordinate column names LATITUDE_GDA94 and LONGITUDE_GDA94; the registered source manifest records the same statement.
citations: NGSA total-Hg product file header, columns LATITUDE_GDA94/LONGITUDE_GDA94 (Geoscience Australia eCat 150328, doi:10.26186/150328)
assets/source_manifest.json sources.australia-ngsa-mercury.scientific_notes: 'Coordinates use GDA94 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4283); the values are retained without an unrecorded transformation.'
datum_evidence_reviews.fail_closed_behavior: GDA94 values are retained as reported coordinates. Canonical WGS84 stays empty because no verified GDA94->WGS84 transformation policy is registered; registering one requires documenting the plate-motion epoch offset before any adapter may opt in via coordinate_evidence_scope=platform_policy_declared.

datum_evidence_reviews.evidence: The ESSD data paper states that site coordinates were recorded with a consumer GPS receiver but never names a datum or EPSG code; the TPDC metadata and workbook are also silent.
citations: Wu et al. (2025), ESSD 17, 4779, Sect. 2.1: 'At each site, the geographic coordinate was recorded using a GPS device (eTrex Venture, USA).' (doi:10.5194/essd-17-4779-2025)
TPDC dataset landing page and 'Description of the dataset.docx' (doi:10.11888/Terre.tpdc.302620): no CRS statement
datum_evidence_reviews.fail_closed_behavior: A GPS-device mention is indirect evidence, not a datum declaration; consumer receivers can be configured to non-WGS84 datums. Canonical coordinates stay empty (fail closed); mapping is available only through --coordinate-mode reported with the unverified-datum banner.

datum_evidence_reviews.evidence: GEOROC precompiled documentation describes included 'geospatial coordinates' without any datum or CRS declaration; values are compiled from heterogeneous literature sources.
citations: https://georoc.eu/georoc/precompiled/ ('Files include metadata such as geospatial coordinates, analytical methods, ...'; no datum statement)
assets/source_manifest.json sources.georoc-archaean.scientific_notes: 'Decimal coordinates must not be labeled EPSG:4326 solely from their numeric format.'
datum_evidence_reviews.fail_closed_behavior: Coordinates remain reported-only; no WGS84 bbox filtering and no canonical promotion. This also covers georoc-antarctica-intraplate, whose exact-point subset keeps the same undeclared-datum boundary.

policies.claim: PANGAEA LATITUDE and LONGITUDE geocodes are decimal degrees referenced to WGS84.
limitations: Applies only to exact PANGAEA geocode fields and a PANGAEA dataset DOI.
Does not validate whether a depositor placed values in the correct columns.
Does not apply to renamed, derived, projected, or user-supplied coordinate columns.
